digest.component_or_area: reconciler committed .bridge_state cache and tickets repository storage
propositions: The tickets branch is 1.04 GiB; 92% is the reconciler's .bridge_state cache due to scattered writes across bindings.json defeating git delta compression, with true marginal cost per version measured at 12.79 KB today.

The baseline_advanced_at field (written at binding_store.py:375, read nowhere) changes 1144 entries per reconciler pass and contributes 7.4x of the growth; deletion reduces marginal cost to 1.74 KB per version.

The last_get_pass rotation bookkeeping field changes 20 entries per pass; moving it to .bridge_state/get_rotation.json combined with baseline_advanced_at deletion halves the version count and achieves 12.8x total cost reduction.

A one-time git fast-export/filter/fast-import history strip reduces the existing 1.17 GiB repository to 98.8 MB (8.4%) while preserving all 49,888 commits and 2,661 merges, with the rewritten HEAD tree byte-identical to the pre-rewrite tip.

Mixed-version read compatibility and fail-closed epoch guards at union sites prevent resurrection after reclaim; rollback is executable via explicit quiesced ref restoration from an off-repo backup bundle without bypassing epoch mismatch refusal.
